steps.what: Select equipment, materials, or parts to purchase
Price the selection from the price table
Sign the purchase list for this version
Send the signed purchase list
outputs: filed copy of signed purchase list v1

tasks.design: The engineer selects the equipment, materials, or parts. A job prices the selection from the price table in {PROCUREMENT}. The engineer signs that list, and only then does a job send it. An unsigned list is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests were mailed from a draft that did not match the price table.
tasks.enabler_now: The price table can price a selected list before anyone sends it.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to buy still depends on the line.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what is purchased and at which version of the list.

ambition.what: Reprice a list when the price table changes, and send only the newly signed version.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the purchase on the selection and the signature.

reach.task: Place the order from the signed list

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says a cost estimate is quantities times a price table, and a model may only read supplier quotes that are checked against totals.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The send stops if the price table changed after signature.
Configure the procurement record before a new store.
unknowns: Who may send a purchase above a set amount.
Whether the engineer or a buyer owns the vendor.
research_questions: How often the price table is updated.

already_counted.description: Selecting what to buy stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate processes for emissions, pollution, energy use, and waste.

steps.what: Evaluate proposed manufacturing processes for environmental sustainability
Join energy, water, and waste totals from records
Judge gas emissions, pollution, and waste creation
Sign the sustainability evaluation
File the signed sustainability evaluation
outputs: filed copy of signed sustainability evaluation v1

tasks.design: A job joins energy, water, and waste totals already in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Energy comes from meter records. The engineer evaluates the proposed process, judges emissions, pollution, and waste creation, signs the evaluation in {DOCS}, and a job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental figures were copied from old slides, not from meters.
tasks.enabler_now: Meter, water, and waste totals can be joined without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: A total does not say whether the proposed process is acceptable.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges the process against those factors.

ambition.what: Refresh the environment pack when a meter period closes, before the evaluation is signed.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the evaluation on the judgement, not on collecting totals.

reach.learn: Which meter period the pack used

evidence.claim: Digest [S17] describes an energy information duty every four years and a research duty above a site threshold, so energy use in this note comes from meter records.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The job does not invent an emission factor.
unknowns: Whether this site owes an energy information return.
research_questions: How complete the water and waste records are.

already_counted.description: Evaluating the process stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Read literature, attend meetings, and keep up with manufacturing developments.

steps.what: List new literature titles and their citations
Read current literature on the manufacturing field
Attend meetings, workshops, or conferences
Discuss developments with colleagues
Sign the learning note for this month
File the signed learning note
outputs: filed copy of signed learning note v1

tasks.design: A desk lists titles and citations already in {DOCS}. The engineer reads the current literature, attends the meetings, and talks with colleagues. The engineer signs a short note of what to try, and a job files that note. The list is not a summary of the source.
tasks.previous_blocker: New papers were easy to miss, and the note of what to try was never filed.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained source list can be listed without a new platform.
tasks.still_hard: Judging a paper still means reading it.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what is worth trying in this plant.
tasks.altitude: Reading, meetings, and conversation do not shrink. Listing titles and filing the note do.

reach.task: Try the idea named in the signed note

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The desk lists citations and does not claim the paper is correct.
unknowns: Which sources the firm already pays for.
Whether conference notes may be filed.
research_questions: How often the useful development is not in the source list.

already_counted.description: Reading and attendance stay inside the remaining time of those steps.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only row collection and filing move to a job. Inspection, the decision, and the signature stay with the engineer, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.short: Redesign packaging to minimize material use or waste.

steps.what: Redesign packaging for manufactured products
Sum raw material quantities from the bill
Choose a pack that cuts material use or waste
Sign the packaging redesign
File the signed packaging note
outputs: filed copy of signed packaging note v1

tasks.design: The engineer redesigns the packaging. A job sums raw material quantities from the bill in {ERP}. The engineer chooses the pack that cuts material or waste, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. The sum is not a claim that waste will fall.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pack ideas were compared without a current material total.
tasks.enabler_now: The bill can be summed by a fixed rule.
tasks.still_hard: A lighter pack can fail in transit.

ambition.what: Show the current material sum beside each pack option before the choice is signed.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the pack, not on summing the bill.

reach.learn: Which bill version the sum used

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S20] records that a paper was withdrawn because the institution had no confidence in its data, so a figure enters a note only when it traces to a source row.

assumptions: The sum uses the bill and does not forecast a saving.
Configure the bill record before a new store.
unknowns: Who signs a pack that touches a regulated label.
research_questions: How often the bill lags the pack that is actually used.

already_counted.description: Redesigning the pack stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

role.altitude: The manufacturing engineer spends the week on cause, design, and the signed decision. Collecting rows and filing a signed note move to a job.
reach: Quality technicians get a field list for the part they collect, instead of a blank request.
Planners wait for the signed note before they move a routing.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no source row.
Release only the version they signed, and leave a safety function to a person.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change note can open a controlled routing update, and the engineer still releases it.
